name: flatplot-vo-1
text: Flat or plot? Every Indian family has this fight. [short pause] So here's what you actually own. Buy a one thousand square foot flat in a tower... and your share of the land under it can be about two hundred and twenty-eight square feet. That's your undivided share of land. In one worked example, two hundred flats split forty thousand square feet of land. [pause] Team plot says: the whole land is yours... and it's the land that tends to gain value while buildings age. Team flat says: security, lifts, a home ready now, and no building to manage. [pause] And if your tower is ever redeveloped... that slice decides what you get. Check it in your sale deed. [pause] Send this to the person in your family who wants a plot.
